name: Asia Times Square
summary: Asia Times Square is one of the largest Asian markets in Texas, offering an authentic cultural experience with over 40 restaurants, shops, and services representing Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Filipino, and other Asian cuisines and traditions. Located in Grand Prairie with easy highway access, this family-friendly destination serves as a cultural hub for the entire Dallas-Fort Worth Asian community.
demographics: Asia Times Square attracts a predominantly Asian-American demographic, with strong representation from Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean, and other Asian communities across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The center draws families and young professionals, typically in the 25-55 age range, with middle to upper-middle income levels who seek authentic Asian cuisine, specialty groceries, and cultural products. Visitors travel from across the mid-cities area and beyond, often making it a destination shopping experience for authentic Asian goods and dining that cannot be found elsewhere in the region. The trade area extends well beyond Grand Prairie, serving as a cultural hub for Asian communities throughout DFW who value authentic products and traditional services.
description: Asia Times Square stands as one of the largest Asian markets in Texas, strategically located in Grand Prairie between four major state highways (360, 161, I-20, and I-30), making it easily accessible from throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. This thoughtfully designed super complex goes far beyond a typical shopping center, serving as a cultural destination that commemorates and honors the Asian community by creating a safe, family-friendly environment filled with authentic restaurants, specialty shops, and services. The center features an impressive array of dining options spanning multiple Asian cuisines, from traditional Vietnamese pho at Pho Hung and Pho Ngon 999, to Mongolian hot pot at Happy Lamb and Little Sheep, Korean fried chicken at Choong Man Chicken, authentic Filipino fare at Cocina Elena, and Cambodian-Thai street food at Apsara. Beyond its renowned food scene, Asia Times Square offers diverse retail and service options including beauty salons like Nancy's Salon and Star Salon, specialty shops like Hong Kong Bakery and Paris Baguette, health and beauty products at Shiseido and The FaceShop, and unique entertainment venues like Bida Em billiards hall. The center has become a beloved gathering place where families can enjoy authentic cultural experiences, from freeze-dried treats at K Puffs to traditional Japanese ramen at Sakari, all while shopping for specialty ingredients and products that connect them to their heritage.
